newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt/currency market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt/currency market closing report.

text.p: Swedish debt yields dropped, taking their cue from markets abroad and a stronger crown.
The market gained further momentum after the release of U.S. August CPI figures.
The undertone of the market remained strong and stable, but the possibility for an upward rebound next week had edged into the picture.
"There will be an upward rebound at some point in time, possibly already on Monday," one dealer said.
Nine year bond yields fell six basis points to 7.85 percent. Six month T-bill rates closed five basis points lower at 4.84 percent.
The crown remained firm throughout the day in exceptionally quiet trade and rose to 4.4170 crowns compared to 4.4210 on Thursday afternoon.
